product_one_liner.value: CompanyCam helps contractors document jobs with time- and location-stamped photos and videos, organize project information, and keep field crews and office teams connected.

eng_blog.notes: Technical publications include API migration from ASP.NET to Rails and integrating React Native into the iOS app, both by CTO Chad Wilken.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Neither readable job-board snapshot lists a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; marketing analytics and general software-engineering roles are excluded.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed AI documentation, MCP documentation, terms, privacy notice and trust/security material. Compatible external AI clients are named, but these do not establish the underlying provider for native product AI. No attributable native model/provider disclosure was found.

compliance_certs.notes: GDPR is claimed as compliance, not an independently issued certification; only the requested frameworks are listed.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 21, 2025. The company did not disclose the amount; $415 million is the PitchBook-reported figure cited by Silicon Prairie News, not a company-confirmed amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 21, 2025 Series C falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The accessible Greenhouse Current Job Openings board lists Account Executive, Outbound and Sales Development Representative, Outbound. Its individual CompanyCam posting links render the general careers page, and the separate Ashby board has a different role set; current availability is therefore less certain than the board listing alone suggests.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 7, 2026 MCP Server announcement and November 4, 2026 blueprint-map feature fall within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On July 2, 2026, Will Martin announced that he was starting as VP of Mid-Market Sales at CompanyCam.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce appears in a current account-manager posting; the other named systems appear in an archived outbound account-executive posting and are historical stack signals, not proof of continued use.
